title: Content Picker and User Picker Fields: Relate Content Items | Orchard Core
description:
Content items rarely stand alone: a bundle lists products, and each bundle has someone who manages it. Typing the same information into every item is repetitive, and a copy goes out of date.

The Content Picker and User Picker fields store a reference to existing content items or users, chosen from a searchable list, so the items stay independent and linked.

In this video:
• Ways to relate content items, and where the pickers fit
• Add a Content Picker field and choose which content types it offers
• Pick content items in the editor and see them on the page
• Add a User Picker field that offers only the users of a role
• Pick from a Lucene index, and the Elasticsearch editor option
• Content pickers at a glance
